definitions.explanation: having power or influence over something or someone

examples.japanese: {支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{態度|たいど}をとる。
この{分野|ぶんや}では{支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{企業|きぎょう}だ。
examples.english: It is a dominant company in this field.

examples.japanese: {支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{性格|せいかく}の{人|ひと}とは{一緒|いっしょ}に{働|はたら}きにくい。
examples.english: It's difficult to work with people who have a controlling personality.

notes:
FORMS:
{支配|しはい} (control/domination) + {的|てき} (suffix making adjective)

USAGE:
- {支配|しはい}{的|てき}な + noun (controlling, dominant)
- {支配|しはい}{的|てき}に + verb (in a controlling manner)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{地位|ちい} - dominant position
- {支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{意見|いけん} - prevailing opinion
- {支配|しはい}{的|てき}な{立場|たちば} - dominant stance

RELATED WORDS:
- {優位|ゆうい} - superiority; dominance
- {権威|けんい}{的|てき} - authoritative
